run_rlhf_http_ipc: run the RLHF example script that syncs model weights from a training model to a vLLM server via CUDA IPC
build_generate_completions: build a function that generates text completions using the OpenAI-compatible API with a vLLM server
create_init_weight_transfer_engine: create a function that initializes the weight transfer engine on the vLLM server via HTTP endpoint
create_IPCWeightTransferEngine_trainer_s: create a function that broadcasts trained model weights to the vLLM server using CUDA IPC handles
run_pause_resume_generation: run functions that pause and resume text generation on the vLLM server during weight synchronization
